title: UUPS Upgradeable Secure Vault Protocol
subtitle: Smart Contract Architecture & Reentrancy-Hardened Vault
summary: Enterprise-grade decentralized vault protocol utilizing the Universal Upgradeable Proxy Standard (UUPS). Implements OpenZeppelin reentrancy protection, role-based access control, and gas-optimized storage slots.

architecture.problem: Traditional immutable smart contracts cannot patch vulnerabilities or upgrade business logic, while naive proxies introduce storage collision and delegatecall hijacking risks.
architecture.solution: Engineered a UUPS (ERC-1822) upgradeable architecture where upgrade logic resides within the implementation contract, shielded behind exclusive owner access control and Checks-Effects-Interactions reentrancy guards.
keyInnovations: UUPS upgradeable pattern reducing proxy gas overhead compared to Transparent proxies
Checks-Effects-Interactions (CEI) pattern combined with OpenZeppelin nonReentrant modifiers
Deterministic storage slot layout preventing collision across contract upgrades
Comprehensive Hardhat unit test suite verifying state persistence across implementation migrations
securityOrPerfPatterns: Custom storage gap reserving for future variable expansions

title: SEPICP: AI Student Engagement & Faculty Platform
subtitle: Agentic LLM Workflow & Research-to-Pedagogy Pipeline
summary: An intelligent academic assessment platform that connects live classroom interaction metrics with agentic LLMs to generate personalized, research-cited pedagogical recommendations for faculty.

architecture.problem: Educators often lack real-time visibility into classroom engagement degradation and struggle to translate generic feedback into evidence-backed instructional improvements.
architecture.solution: Constructed an end-to-end multi-agent pipeline using React, Django, and MySQL that ingests classroom surveys, decomposes engagement bottlenecks, and matches them to peer-reviewed pedagogical research papers.
keyInnovations: Multi-stage agentic workflow: survey decomposition -> intent taxonomy -> academic paper retrieval -> actionable advice synthesis
Automated cross-referencing against verified educational research repositories
Predictive engagement analytics dashboard for faculty members with course-level trend forecasting
securityOrPerfPatterns: Strict prompt guardrails preventing hallucinated paper citations
Batched query processing for sub-second dashboard latency

title: Autonomous On-Chain Arbitrage & Liquidity Agent
subtitle: AI-Driven Smart Contract Execution Engine
summary: The convergence of Web3 and Agentic AI: an autonomous off-chain agent that analyzes liquidity pool imbalances, calculates gas-bounded trade profitability, and executes atomic smart contract calls.

architecture.problem: Manual on-chain portfolio rebalancing and DeFi interactions are vulnerable to frontrunning, high slippage, and delayed human execution.
architecture.solution: Built a Python/TypeScript agent loop monitoring mempool event streams, simulating multi-hop swaps in a local fork, and broadcasting signed atomic transactions only when verified profitable.
keyInnovations: Agentic reasoning loop determining optimal slippage tolerances based on real-time gas prices
Atomic fallback contract ensuring transactions revert if profit thresholds aren't satisfied
Private RPC routing mitigating predatory MEV searcher exploitation
securityOrPerfPatterns: Atomic execution via flash loan callbacks
Slippage bounds verified on-chain at execution time
architecture.contractOrModelType: Autonomous Financial Agent + Custom Smart Contract Router

title: Smart Event & Tiered Ticket Management Protocol
subtitle: High-Concurrency Relational Architecture
summary: An enterprise-grade event ticketing platform supporting tiered seating, real-time inventory locking, and concurrent transaction serialization built with Node.js, React, and Oracle XE.

architecture.problem: High-demand concert and event ticketing frequently experiences race conditions, seat double-booking, and inventory desynchronization under high load.
architecture.solution: Engineered a normalized relational database schema with row-level locks and optimistic concurrency controls on Oracle XE, coordinated by an Express.js API gateway.
keyInnovations: Database-level transaction isolation preventing double allocation of premium seats
Multi-tier permission model separating attendees, organizers, and audit inspectors
Dynamic seat mapping with interactive SVG venue layouts
securityOrPerfPatterns: Pessimistic seat locking with automatic 10-minute hold expiration

title: ATS-Compliant Document Assembly Engine
subtitle: Reactive Form State to Standardized Word/PDF Export
summary: An automated document assembly web application designed strictly around Applicant Tracking System constraints, built with TypeScript, React, and Supabase.

architecture.problem: Modern design-heavy resume builders produce graphic formats that fail automated ATS parsing filters used by Fortune 500 recruiters.
architecture.solution: Built a structured resume editor that guarantees 100% parseable output by enforcing semantic field schemas and compiling directly to standardized docx/pdf streams.
keyInnovations: Strict ATS parser compatibility engine scoring layout readability
Reactive real-time preview synced with Supabase authenticated cloud storage
One-click multi-format export pipeline without layout degradation
securityOrPerfPatterns: Row-Level Security (RLS) on Supabase user resumes

title: POM Quality Analytical Data Processing Module
subtitle: High-Throughput Quality Metric Automation
summary: An internal analytical web application to monitor, filter, and process manufacturing quality metrics. Led frontend module architecture and transitioned specialized Python evaluation scripts into production.

architecture.problem: Manual review of multi-point quality evaluation logs introduced multi-day delays in flagging manufacturing defects.
architecture.solution: Developed automated Python ingestion modules paired with a modular React frontend to visualize and score quality variance in real time.
keyInnovations: Micro-modular frontend layout enabling rapid toggling of analytical filters
Python data pipeline transforming raw sensor logs into normalized quality scores
